name: SDL_mixer-compatible PCM effects profile
implementation: Original repository implementation; not an upstream SDL_mixer release
source_api: Bounded subset of SDL_mixer 1.2 effect-channel APIs
dependency: Pinned SDL 1.2.15 PCM WAV and AudioCVT implementation; see ../PROVENANCE.json
limits: Signed 16-bit channel/count ABI (32767); checked dynamic allocation; uncompressed PCM WAV and raw PCM; no music/compressed codecs; cooperative SDL callbacks
